==Notes==
*If you would like to have the added benefits of Feel No Pain ''without'' the screen effects of being drunk open the game options menu and on the graphics tab uncheck "Enable post process effects".
*The use of one 1 point [[alcohol]] just before you activate the skill is enough to trigger the bonus effects.

==Trivia==
*The woman on the [[skill icon]] is [[Jora]] in [[:Image:Jora Brotherhood armor.jpg|Brotherhood Armor]].
